primary_question: Can independent Ross Sea colonies provide observed annual count context for Ross Island rebound and Cape Barne's documented historic non-reoccupation without interpreting pair count changes as identified dispersal, chick survival or individual higher-order memory?
strict_source_quality_gates: Use official CKAN public resource_show to retrieve the exact resource file URL, not guessed download paths.
Strict official HTTPS host allowlist; stop if host/protocol redirects to third-party or downgrade.
Validate published resource MD5, image/app HTML rejected, ZIP/XLSX structure checked before reading data.
Never treat total summary row as an extra 40th independent penguin colony.
Preserve 2020 mixed text cell types, NA, blanks, no survey and original zero as distinct until documented source codebook.
No interpolate missing annual colony counts, no silent missing-to-zero conversion.
Do not conclude Cape Barne absent solely because omitted from 39-colony survey roster.
Do not confuse Cape Crozier/Royds/Bird subcolonies on Ross Island with independent islands.
Do not treat breeding-pair change as movement, recruitment, source-sink or adult demographic history.
Respect CC-BY-NC source licence and do not redistribute entire third-party xlsx in mina.
